engine: Charisma governs Oath DC/M and divine technique attacks. Weapon attacks use their ordinary Strength/Dexterity ability. Hit Die d10; all armor, shields, simple and martial weapons. Paladin has no Conviction or Oracle Revelation Charges. Lay on Hands is its own pool,5×Paladin level, fully restored only by long rest. Ordinary spells and printed Smite fuel use the same Paladin CoreV2 RP pool; healing points never convert to RP.

Base progression is explicit rather than the ordinary25-card template: at1 automatically gain Lay on Hands, Divine Sense, Martial Proficiency, Divine Strike, Protective Stance and Sacred Touch. At2 gain Righteous Challenge, Bolstering Presence, Fighting Style and ordinary Paladin spell access. At3 swear ONE of ten Oaths; gain only its Smite modification, Aura and first Revelation spell. This Oath is the Arch specialization. At10 enter Hero Oath Mastery of that SAME Oath; no second Oath or additional generic Hero tree. Signature Power unlocks11, Final Gift20. Oath Revelations automatically unlock3/5/9/13/17, always known in addition to the shared spell repertoire, rank1/2/3/4/5 respectively. Exact printed RP costs replace generic cost only if the card explicitly supplies them.

At2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1AC while armored; Dueling +2damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

Divine Strike at1: after one melee weapon hit on your regular turn, spend1RP to add S d6 radiant. At2 this becomes Divine Smite: choose1RP for S d6 or2RP for(S+1)d8 radiant, once/own turn total. Oath3 changes type/rider as its card states, never adds another copy of the base damage. Smite is not an ordinary spell, cannot be counterspelled or generically Overcast, and causes no Dissonance. A critical hit doubles Smite damage dice under ordinary rules, but never healing, resources or percentage copies.

One Oath aura, requires consciousness and no concentration. Radius10ft at3,15ft at6,20ft at10,30ft at15. Benefits affect up to3 allies or3 enemies as the Oath card states, chosen at start of your turn and changed next turn; they must stay within aura. At6 choose one additional aura benefit for that day: allies+1saves against fear/charm, or1flatDR against weapon damage. At7 once/short rest when enemy damages an ally in aura, Reaction make one melee attack if in reach; may pay normal Smite cost even off turn, but total Smite maximum one per round from this reactive feature. At10 aura persists until start of your next regular turn after incapacitation; then ends if still incapacitated. At15 also grant selected allies+1initiative while in aura when initiative is rolled; no retroactive turn changes.

At17 Aura Surge once/short rest Bonus Action: until start next turn choose up to3 allies in aura to gain S+M temporary HP and+1saves. This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius30ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

Protected interface: Smite, Aura and Lay on Hands generate no Weave Dissonance. After a successful direct melee hit, your next Oath spell before end next turn generates1less Dissonance, minimum0, consuming the benefit. No stacking, RP discount or Refrain reset. Oath Revelation spells and the five replacement Forbidden spells below are ordinary spells for strain, countering and concentration; signature powers and final gifts are Oath techniques unless expressly tagged otherwise.

Oath conduct clauses remain intact in source and Oath cards. The Director identifies a relevant clause and a knowingly chosen serious breach before applying a fall. A disagreement, failed roll, coerced act or unknown fact does not silently remove a character. A fall is an explicit story transition recorded with the player: choose the corresponding Oathbreaker inversion or pursue an agreed restoration scene. Preserve class level and already spent resources. Oathbreaker replaces its Oath Aura, Smite rider, Signature and Revelation list, rather than stacking both sets. Base martial abilities remain; Lay on Hands becomes Death Touch using the same current5L pool, with no refill on switching.

Death Touch baseline: Action melee divine attack PB+CHA; declare and spend1 through2S+M points before the attack from remaining Lay on Hands pool to deal that much necrotic damage (choose amount before roll; miss still spends declared points). Each Oath inversion may alter type or add its bounded rider; never copy innate traits, confiscate class engines or automatically execute a target. A listed inverted Signature is available only at11 and replaces the ordinary Signature use, one/short rest. An inverted aura follows the same radius, target cap and timing. Oathbreaker20 uses the new Black Manifestation common capstone instead of its original Final Gift.

The source names a Forbidden Spell List but does not supply five complete entries for each inversion. This pilot explicitly adds one shared five-spell replacement list (below), with each Oathbreaker using its inversion name as flavor. These are new test rules, not recovered historical spells. Choose the normal Oath package OR inverted package at a time. All later Oath prerequisites still use Paladin class level; the Oathbreaker label does not bypass3/11/20 gates.

Oath integration limits: one paid Smite total per round, including the level-7 Reaction; one Oath-aura reactive event per round. Multiple damage-redirection options share one event per round unless Crown Undying expressly allows two. Apply original-target defenses once, then split actual damage; transferred damage cannot be mitigated again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources. This explicit rule supersedes wording that permits recipient defenses again.

Sustained Oath spell damage/healing zones use concentration, at most three pulses, and 1 RP upkeep after the first pulse unless a priced card expressly supplies a different finite cadence. Native Oath auras retain their printed passive cadence and target cap. Final auras last their stated finite duration and include their pulses. All hard-denial effects, including compelled Actions, share the common once/source/target/encounter guard; later failures only remove Reactions and reduce Speed by half for one turn.

An emergency Reaction whose trigger itself incapacitates you, such as Grace Reversal or Thorn Crown, may resolve before that incapacitation only if you had a Reaction available before the triggering event. This grants no other actions while incapacitated. Narrative labels such as oppressor require a specific act of captivity/coercion established in the scene, not an alignment or identity assumption.

The source ceiling’s half-pool-per-round Lay on Hands cap is a preserved alternative. This pilot instead uses maximum class level per ordinary Lay on Hands Action and the explicitly once-per-long-rest level-17 Wave that distributes the current remaining pool. No normal heal gains the Wave’s exception.

For any one damage event choose exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Using it consumes the shared redirection allowance for that round. Crown Undying permits two DIFFERENT ally-damage events per round, but still only one redirection feature may modify each event.

On later turns the effect only imposes Charmed and, on a failed repeat save, no Reactions and half Speed until the next turn; it cannot command another Action.

extraCards.name: Sovereign Mandate
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies or enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 1 minute
extraCards.effect: Selected allies have advantage on saving throws against Charm, Fear and compulsion. Re-selecting the same enemy on later turns grants another save rather than extending automatically.

extraCards.name: Sovereign's Ascendance
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: Choose up to 3 creatures in your aura. An allied target gains advantage on Charisma saves and +2 on Intimidation checks for 3 rounds. A hostile target immediately receives Heaven's Decree without an initial save and must choose whether to obey its bounded command or take the normal psychic backlash. Until the end of its next turn it also cannot knowingly speak a direct falsehood in your presence. This Final does not permit self-harm commands, forced belief, confession or permanent allegiance.

extraCards.name: Death Touch — Tyrant's Grasp
extraCards.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss

extraCards.duration: Control rider until end of target's next turn
extraCards.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
extraCards.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared points. The target then makes a Wisdom save. The rider cannot cause self-harm, belief change or permanent control.

extraCards.name: Obey Aura
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets and one prohibition at start of your turn
extraCards.effect: State one simple prohibition for the selected enemies: do not approach me, do not leave this area, do not attack a named visible creature, or do not speak. extraCards.name: Obey
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura that can hear you
extraCards.duration: Until end of each target's next turn
extraCards.effect: State one bounded command: Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, Halt or Release. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it chooses at the start of its next turn either obey the command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one ordinary Action, or refuse and take 2S d6 psychic damage. Player-controlled targets make that choice themselves. No command can require self-harm, confession, belief change or permanent allegiance.

extraCards.name: Purifying Smite
extraCards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous
extraCards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
extraCards.effect: Choose fire or radiant when you Smite; the entire Smite packet uses that type. If the target is undead or a fiend, after damage choose one temporary magical buff, disease-like enhancement, curse-derived boon or other removable beneficial condition currently affecting it. If the effect is within ordinary dispelling scope, end it. This purge never removes innate creature traits, class engines or permanent statistics.

extraCards.name: Aura of Purification
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: A selected living ally has advantage on disease saving throws. A selected hostile undead creature takes S radiant damage at the start of its turn while still in the aura. This pulse occurs at most once per creature per round and cannot generate resource or damage-reflection loops.

extraCards.name: Holy Inferno
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous
extraCards.effect: Choose each target as hostile or allied. A hostile target makes a Dexterity save, taking S d8 fire plus S d8 radiant damage on failure or half on success. An allied target takes no damage and may end one of Poisoned, Diseased if magically curable, or a finite curse that ordinary cleansing could remove. Holy Inferno is an Oath technique rather than an ordinary spell.

extraCards.name: Cleansing Brand
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous
extraCards.effect: Make a spell attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal 2d6 fire damage. On a natural 20, after damage you may end one curse affecting the target that an ordinary curse-removal effect of this tier could legally remove; if removing it would benefit a hostile target, you may decline. The critical cleansing removes no innate traits, Oath, class engine or artifact-level curse.

extraCards.name: Zealot's Flame
extraCards.cost: 3 RP; optional 1 RP per aura pulse after the first
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one wielded weapon; hostile undead in your aura
extraCards.duration: Concentration; maximum three rounds
extraCards.effect: Your chosen weapon deals +1d6 fire damage on the first hit you land each turn. The first time during this cast that you hit, you may end one disease affecting yourself if that disease permits magical cleansing. On activation choose up to three hostile undead in your aura; they take 1d6 radiant damage. At the start of each of your next two turns you may pay 1 RP to repeat this pulse against up to three current aura targets. Each target is affected once per round. If you decline upkeep, the aura pulses end; the weapon buff may continue for the remaining duration.

extraCards.name: Purge the Tainted
extraCards.cost: 5 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance after the first pulse
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered within 30 feet; up to 3 undead or fiends per pulse
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 pulses
extraCards.effect: Resolve one pulse on activation. On each of your next 2 regular turns, pay 1 RP and a Bonus Action to pulse again. At each pulse choose up to 3 undead or fiends in the zone. Each makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 radiant damage on failure or half on success. Each creature is affected once per pulse.

extraCards.name: Sanctified Immolation
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Your next Smite or Holy Inferno before end of your next regular turn
extraCards.duration: Until consumed or end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: The empowered Smite or Holy Inferno ignores fire resistance, but not immunity. Against undead, add 1d6 radiant damage to one damage roll. If a creature damaged by the empowered effect is currently affected by a removable curse or disease, you may end one such condition on that creature after damage; this cannot remove innate traits, artifact curses or class features.

extraCards.name: Phoenix Rebirth
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One living ally in your Oath aura reduced to 0 HP
extraCards.duration: Revival instantaneous; fire shield until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: Trigger when the ally reaches 0 HP without being killed outright. It immediately regains HP equal to half its maximum, rounded down, minimum 1. Until the end of its next turn it has fire resistance. Once during that duration when a creature within melee reach damages it with a melee attack, that attacker takes 2d6 fire damage. Phoenix Rebirth removes no Wounds and cannot restore a creature destroyed beyond recovery.

extraCards.name: Purifying Crown
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: For 3 rounds, a selected allied creature is immune to Poisoned and ordinary disease. A selected hostile undead or fiend takes S d6 fire plus S d6 radiant damage at the start of its turn, at most once per round. When the Crown activates, restore one expended use of Holy Inferno, even if it was used since the last short rest. This restoration occurs once and cannot recurse.

extraCards.name: Death Touch — Blighting Blood
extraCards.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within melee reach; its occupied space
extraCards.duration: Damage instantaneous; blighted space until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; terrain rider once per turn
extraCards.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared points and blight the target's space until the start of your next turn. The first hostile creature other than the original target that enters or starts its turn in that space takes S necrotic damage. The patch creates no corpse, healing or resource trigger.

extraCards.name: Scorch the Sanctified
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: Selected enemies cannot regain HP from passive regeneration. At the start of each selected enemy's turn it makes a Charisma save. On failure, one temporary beneficial magical effect on it chosen by the Director from eligible non-innate effects is suppressed until the start of its next turn. Immunities, class engines, permanent traits and attunement are never suppressed.

extraCards.name: Scorch the Sanctified — Blasphemous Word
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; suppressed effect until end of next turn
extraCards.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking S d6 fire plus S d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A failing target also has one eligible temporary beneficial spell or regeneration effect suppressed until the end of its next turn. You may knowingly include allies among the targets; the effect offers them no protection.

extraCards.name: Ancient Smite
extraCards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
extraCards.duration: Root rider until end of target's next turn
extraCards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
extraCards.effect: Choose force or radiant; the entire Smite packet uses that type. If the triggering weapon attack is a critical hit, the target makes a Strength save; fey and elementals have disadvantage. On failure its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. This rooting does not remove its Action or Reaction and therefore is not a full-turn denial.

extraCards.name: Aura of Remembrance
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: A selected ally gains +1 on saves against Charmed. If a selected hostile fey or elemental attempts its first attack against you during a turn, it makes a Wisdom save before rolling; on failure that attack has disadvantage. The creature may still choose another legal target.

extraCards.name: Thorn Crown
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature that just imposed a condition on you within 60 feet
extraCards.duration: Reflected condition maximum 1 round
extraCards.effect: Trigger after a hostile creature causes you to fail a save and gain a finite-duration condition. The source immediately makes the same type of saving throw against your Oath DC. On failure it suffers the same named condition until the end of its next turn, subject to the universal hard-denial guard. Your original condition is not removed unless another feature removes it. Thorn Crown cannot reflect damage, death, curses, Wounds, resource loss or permanent transformations.

extraCards.name: Roots of Memory
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 10 feet of a creature you just damaged with Smite
extraCards.duration: Until end of each target's next turn
extraCards.frequency: At will while RP remains; once per Smite
extraCards.effect: Trigger after your Smite resolves. Each chosen target makes a Strength save. On failure it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. A fey, elemental or creature directly bound to an ancient magical site has disadvantage on this save. If at least one such creature fails, you learn one truthful broad fact about its origin category, such as native plane, elemental affinity, fey court or connection to the local ancient site.

extraCards.name: Primal Ward
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: Choose cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Selected allies gain resistance to that damage type while in your aura and while this spell lasts. During the Ward, fey and elementals have disadvantage on saving throws caused directly by your Ancients Smite rider or Oath of the Ancients techniques. This does not impose disadvantage on unrelated spells or attacks.

extraCards.name: Echo of Ages
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 1 minute
extraCards.effect: Selected allies have advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened. When a selected hostile fey or elemental first enters your aura or is selected there, it makes a Wisdom save. After suffering this attack denial once from you in the encounter, later failed saves instead remove its Reaction and reduce Speed by half until the end of its next turn.

extraCards.name: Standing Stone

extraCards.duration: Concentration, 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: The zone is difficult terrain for enemies and normal terrain for allies you choose when casting. It saves again each turn; no creature loses Actions or Reactions solely from Standing Stone.

extraCards.name: Primordial Surge
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Temporary HP until lost; root until end of target's next turn

You may mix allied and hostile targets but can select no more than 3 total creatures.

extraCards.name: Primordial Crown
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: For 3 rounds Thorn Crown can trigger once per round without consuming its short-rest use or paying RP. A selected allied target has advantage on saves against Charmed. A selected hostile fey or elemental makes a Wisdom save at the start of each turn; on failure it cannot attack allies other than you until the start of its next turn, though it may take other actions. The same creature remains subject to the universal denial cap.

extraCards.name: Death Touch — Blighted Step
extraCards.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within melee reach and its occupied space
extraCards.duration: Damage instantaneous; terrain until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; terrain rider once per turn
extraCards.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared points. The blight cannot permanently destroy fertile land or create harvestable resources.

extraCards.name: Lifeleech Bloom Aura
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets and one damage type at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: Selected enemies cannot regain HP from passive regeneration. Also choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, radiant or thunder. A selected enemy's resistance to that chosen type is suppressed while it remains selected in the aura; immunity is never suppressed.
extraCards.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Ancients

extraCards.name: Lifeleech Bloom
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living creatures or plant creatures in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous
extraCards.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2S d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. You regain HP equal to half the total actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum Paladin level+M. You may include willing allies among the targets, but they receive no protection and cannot be reduced below 1 HP by this Blasphemous Word. Constructs and ordinary unattended plants provide no healing.

extraCards.name: Silent Smite
extraCards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous
extraCards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
extraCards.effect: Choose psychic or radiant; the entire Smite packet uses that type. If you have not spoken since the end of your previous regular turn, add S flat damage to the Smite. extraCards.name: Aura of Stillness
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: Selected allies gain +1 on concentration saves. Ordinary loud noises originating inside the aura are reduced to conversational volume at its boundary; this does not create magical Silence, prevent speech, stop verbal spell components or suppress sonic damage unless another feature explicitly says so.

extraCards.name: Vow Unbroken
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self
extraCards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: If you have not spoken since the beginning of your previous regular turn, invoke the Vow. Until the start of your next turn, your next Smite adds one extra die matching its normal Smite die. If you speak before that Smite resolves, the bonus is lost. This does not grant a free Smite, extra attack or additional Smite use.

extraCards.name: Hush
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot speak or use abilities explicitly requiring verbal components until the end of its next turn. If you have not spoken since combat began, the target also has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the effect ends. This does not prevent purely mental or nonverbal abilities.

extraCards.name: Quiet Step
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: For up to 3 rounds your movement produces no ordinary sound, you gain advantage on Stealth checks based on movement noise, and moving at full Speed does not impose a Stealth penalty solely for speed. Attacking, speaking or causing obvious environmental disturbance can still reveal your position normally.

extraCards.name: Wordless Ward
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 30 feet targeted by an attack or damaging effect
extraCards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Grant the ally +2 AC against the triggering attack and reduce the first damage it takes before the start of your next turn by S+M, minimum 0. Wordless Ward requires no speech or verbal component and therefore functions while Silenced. It remains an ordinary spell for Dissonance and Counterspell interactions.

extraCards.name: Still Mind
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies in your Oath aura if silence breaks
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: While you remain voluntarily silent, you are immune to Charmed and Frightened. If you voluntarily speak before the spell ends, those immunities end immediately and up to 3 chosen allies in your aura gain +2 on concentration saves until the start of your next regular turn. Involuntary vocalization does not break the spell.

extraCards.name: Silent Judgment
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Your next Smite before end of current turn
extraCards.duration: Until consumed; rider until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: Your next Smite this turn makes no audible supernatural report beyond the weapon strike itself and does not automatically alert creatures outside ordinary sensory range. On hit the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it cannot speak or use verbal components until the end of its next turn. After resolving the Smite, you gain advantage on Stealth checks until you next speak, make another overtly loud attack or the end of your next regular turn.

extraCards.name: Vow Absolute
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Until encounter ends, you voluntarily speak, or one minute, whichever is first
extraCards.effect: For the duration, each Smite you use while silent adds psychic damage equal to half its base rolled Smite dice total before critical extra dice, rounded down, minimum 1. Up to 3 chosen enemies in your aura cannot use verbal spell components while selected. The first Smite you use each round does not count as breaking your vow despite any involuntary sound. Voluntarily speaking ends the Final immediately. No free Smite or attack is granted. At each selected enemy’s turn start it makes a Charisma save, using verbal components normally on success; the aura does not remove nonverbal abilities.

extraCards.name: Death Touch — Silent Heretic

extraCards.name: Null Command Aura
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: Selected enemies cannot use verbal spell components while in the aura unless they succeed on a Charisma save at the start of their turn. On success they may use verbal components normally until that turn ends. This aura does not prevent speech, nonverbal powers or ordinary weapon actions.

extraCards.name: Null Command
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Damage instantaneous; silence until end of next turn
extraCards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success. A failing target also cannot speak or use verbal components until the end of its next turn. The effect does not remove Actions, Reactions or nonverbal class features.

extraCards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack; one bonded ally in your aura
extraCards.duration: Smite instantaneous; redirection once before your next turn
extraCards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
extraCards.effect: The Smite deals radiant damage normally. After it resolves, choose one ally in your aura as bonded until the start of your next regular turn. Once before then when that ally takes damage, you may redirect up to max(3, actual Charisma modifier) of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage retains type and cannot be redirected again; the original target’s defenses apply once before transfer, with no further mitigation.

extraCards.name: Aura of Bonds
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: Each selected ally reduces the first damage it takes each round by S. Multiple Aura of Bonds effects do not stack. This protection does not redirect damage and therefore does not trigger effects that require you to personally absorb damage.

extraCards.name: Warden's Lock
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered within 30 feet; up to 3 enemies
extraCards.duration: 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: Choose up to 3 enemies in the zone. The first time each selected enemy attempts to leave the zone during a turn, it makes a Strength save. On failure its movement stops at the boundary for that turn. It may still take other Actions and can try again on a later turn with a new save. Forced movement can carry it out normally.

extraCards.name: Linked Ward
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: Mark one willing ally. Once per round when it takes damage, use your Reaction to redirect up to 2 times your actual Charisma modifier, minimum 2, of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage keeps its type and cannot be redirected again. If this redirected damage reduces you to 0 HP, the ally gains temporary HP equal to the amount you actually absorbed, maximum Paladin level+M.

extraCards.name: Chain of Duty
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 30 feet
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: Mark the ally. If it is reduced to 0 HP while within 60 feet and on the same plane, you may use your Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to it. This teleport prevents no damage and does not heal either creature. The spell then ends.

extraCards.name: Martyr's Share
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One ally in your Oath aura taking damage
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous
extraCards.effect: Redirect half the ally's incoming damage, rounded down, to yourself. The ally takes the remainder. Redirected damage keeps its original type and cannot be redirected again. Your portion cannot be mitigated again after the original target’s defenses have applied. Effects attached to the original hit remain on the original target unless they explicitly depend on damage being dealt.

extraCards.name: Unbreakable Bond
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Concentration, maximum 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: The ally is immune to Charmed and Frightened and cannot be compelled to take an action by magical control while the spell lasts. Once per round when the ally would fail a save against a mind-control effect not already prevented by this spell’s immunities, you may use your Reaction to become the target of that effect instead if it could legally affect you. You make no replacement save; resolve the failed-save effect against you.

extraCards.name: Final Stand
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally in your Oath aura
extraCards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Until the start of your next turn, all damage that would be dealt to the chosen ally is redirected to you instead. The redirected damage retains type, cannot be redirected again and cannot be mitigated again after the original target’s defenses apply once. If redirected damage reduces you to 0 HP, the ally immediately gains temporary HP equal to your Paladin level and resistance to all damage until the end of its next turn. This effect ends if you die outright.

extraCards.name: Unbroken Covenant
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Your full Oath aura; up to 3 bonded allies
extraCards.duration: 3 rounds
extraCards.effect: For 3 rounds Warden's Lock fills your entire current Oath aura. Choose up to 3 allies there as bonded. Whenever you redirect damage from a bonded ally to yourself, that ally gains temporary HP equal to half the actual damage you absorb, rounded down, maximum S+M per event. Temporary HP do not stack. This Final grants no extra Reactions.

extraCards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
extraCards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
extraCards.effect: A selected enemy has Speed reduced by 10 feet, minimum 5 feet. The first time each round it willingly moves farther from you, it makes a Strength save; on failure its movement ends after 5 feet of that movement. This does not remove Actions or prevent forced movement.

extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
